annotations.title: Check if a power bank can fly

description: Says whether a verified power bank can go in carry-on luggage, based only on the Wh rating the brand states (under 100Wh: no airline approval needed). Recalled models always return "recalled, do not fly". Includes the rule used and the product source.

lang.description: Language of text fields (notes, labels, answers). One of: "en" (English), "zh-hant" (Traditional Chinese), "zh-hans" (Simplified Chinese). Default "en". Spec values and model numbers are the same in every language. Example: "zh-hant".

product.description: Required. The power bank to check: its slug, model number, another model number it is sold under, or words from its name (1 to 120 characters, case ignored). Products from other categories are rejected. Example: "A1695" or "Anker Prime 20K".

name: check_power_bank_flight
title: Check if a power bank can fly
